thesis: Selected e-commerce coaching distinguishes an owner's diagnosis from the advisor's view of core value.
summary: One owner describes the restructuring thought necessary to make a business sellable. A later advisory passage questions whether logistics should consume attention when distribution and sales create the relevant advantage. This selected review does not cover all coaching cases or validate the owner's general claims about service-business multiples.
